T1053.long: Utilities such as at and schtasks, along with the Windows Task Scheduler, can be used to schedule programs or scripts to be executed at a date and time. A task can also be scheduled on a remote system, provided the proper authentication is met to use RPC and file and printer sharing is turned on. Scheduling a task on a remote system typically required being a member of the Administrators group on the the remote system.

Abstraction is often one floor above you.I hear that Nancy is very pretty.He watched the dancing piglets with panda bear tummies in the swimming pool.He invested some skill points in Charisma and Strength.She had a difficult time owning up to her own crazy self.The hand sanitizer was actually clear glue.You bite up because of your lower jaw.It's not often you find a soggy banana on the street.The elephant didn't want to talk about the person in the room.Don't step on the broken glass.Nothing is as cautiously cuddly as a pet porcupine.There was coal in his stocking and he was thrilled.Please tell me you don't work in a morgue.I currently have 4 windows open up… and I don’t know why.I am my aunt's sister's daughter.The complicated school homework left the parents trying to help their kids quite confused.He created a pig burger out of beef.All she wanted was the answer, but she had no idea how much she would hate
